credits: Imagery: contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025-2026 (Sentinel-2 L2A via Element 84 Earth Search on AWS)
Buildings: Overture Maps Foundation (ODbL), incl. OpenStreetMap, Microsoft ML Buildings and Google Open Buildings
Terrain: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA (cleaned)
Tree cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 © ESA (CC BY 4.0); species are estimated by area
Boat, house, civic-building and cathedral models: fan-made Blender models (web/models)

Long Xuyen Cathedral: original exterior meshes and baked 1K maps; footprint OSM way 674801676 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/674801676, ODbL); proportions: VOV parish interview (https://vovworld.vn/discovery-vietnam/long-xuyen-cathedral-boasts-distinctive-catholic-architecture-2411274.vov5) and Mary Ann Sullivan architectural photographs (https://homepages.bluffton.edu/~sullivanm/vietnam/longxuyen/cathedral/cathedral.html). Reference photographs are not included as textures

Central Long Xuyen detail: original round annex, Hoang Dieu twin bridge, Nguyen Hue garden and north canal courtyard meshes with original baked 1K maps; OSM footprints/alignments (ODbL), https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/683146277 and https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/566005151. Building appearance estimates use privately supplied aerial references (not redistributed); Co.opmart identity: https://media.angiang.gov.vn/pictures/2021/06/11/777-danh%20sach%20dia%20diem%20tham%20gia%20ban%20hang_bott.pdf; Dong Xuyen vicinity: https://www.dongxuyenhotel.vn/. Tree positions and garden island are approximate
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
District boundaries: geoBoundaries / OCHA ROAP (CC BY 3.0 IGO)
Story locations: fan interpretation of Cửu Long Quái Sự Ký © Lâm Gia – Thái Bảo

Foliage/aquatic/rice textures: illustrative adaptations of CC0 LeafSet022, LeafSet024 and Foliage008 photographs; not species-specific photographs.
Rice-field cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 © ESA (CC BY 4.0); plot divisions and crop stages are illustrative

Co.opmart Long Xuyen: original Blender exterior and original 1K baked sign atlas; cached Overture footprint matched to supplied reference photos (reference only, not redistributed). Store identity/address: https://co-opmart.com.vn/he-thong-sieu-thi/co-opmart-long-xuyen; facade and 14.2 x 9.5 m advertising panel: https://billboardquangcao.com/san-pham/trung-tam-thuong-mai-coopmart-long-xuyen. Reference photos are not included as textures. Proportions and unseen parts estimated; brand names identify the landmark

An Giang University main campus: original Blender exterior and original baked surface/lettering textures; OSM university way 995513829 and building ways 674697655, 674697656, 835792473, 835792474, 835792475 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/995513829, ODbL), supplemented by existing cached Overture building footprints (https://overturemaps.org/). Address and visual references: https://www.agu.edu.vn/en/about/overview; https://hop.agu.edu.vn/gallery-co-so-vat-chat; https://www.agu.edu.vn/vi/tuyen-sinh/gioi-thieu-ve-agu. Campus lawn: Poly Haven grass_ground (https://polyhaven.com/a/grass_ground, CC0); foliage: existing original atlas composition using ambientCG LeafSet024 (https://ambientcg.com/view?id=LeafSet024, CC0). Reference photographs are not included as textures. Heights, planting and unseen elevations are estimated

Long Xuyên road corrections: owner-supplied non-Google references; official Long Xuyên/An Giang planning facts and Báo An Giang project reports; full URLs and per-field evidence in scripts/overrides/roads.provenance.json.

Mekong building kit: original project geometry and shared atlas (no copied photos or logos); architecture context: user-supplied An Giang references and the An Giang official tourism guide (https://media.angiang.gov.vn/SoVHTTDL-Portal/File-Dinh-Kem/thong_tin_du_lich_an_giang.pdf)

Yards: estimated decoration from existing Overture footprints (CDLA Permissive 2.0), OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), modified Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery and ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC BY 4.0); modular geometry original/CC0, foliage/plaster/wood CC0 donors in models/yards/kit.json.
Trà Sư forest kit: original geometry, leaf and aquatic-plant atlas artwork (CC0); bark from Poly Haven (CC0, https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_willow)

Road furniture: original Blender geometry and shared atlas; estimated placements from cached OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Historical QCVN 41:2019/BGTVT design reference (https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/12/30665/30013-1-2020211-21254-2019-tt-bgtvt.pdf); school signs: official handbook (https://cdn.haiphong.gov.vn/gov-hpg/SiteFolders/xadongphuong/5973/tintuc/2024/3/so-tay-atgt-truong-hoc638460206614705423.pdf). Synthetic kilometre posts use extract-relative chainage, not official chainage. Physical sign positions are not surveyed.

Mekong bridges: original meshes and matte vertex palette; cached OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL). Vam Cong proportions: ADB (https://www.adb.org/projects/40255-033/main), ITST (https://itst.gov.vn/tin-tuc/hop-long-cau-vam-cong-vao-thang-9-2017/), Nhan Dan on-site report (https://en.nhandan.vn/final-segment-installed-on-longest-cable-stayed-bridge-in-mekong-delta-post54462.html), MRC navigation guide (https://navigation.mrcmekong.org/vietnam/en_us/63-2/bridges-and-cables/). Reference material only, no copied photo pixels. Unspecified local construction and clearance are estimates.

Mekong banks: original assets on the existing water-mask contour; estimated reeds, erosion and settlement access, cached OpenStreetMap parks/piers (ODbL). Existing Long Xuyen embankment context: 2017 official ESIA (https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/720761484289429214/pdf/SFG2827-V3-REVISED-EA-P159397-Box402906B-PUBLIC-Disclosed-5-4-2017.pdf). Chau Doc official context (https://chaudoc.angiang.gov.vn/index.php/phuong-chau-doc-hop-ban-phuong-di-doi-vat-kien-truc-phuc-vu-du-ke-chong-sat-lo); proposals are not represented as completed works. No mask boundaries traced from Google imagery.

Near mango, coconut and banana: original project geometry and illustrative adaptations of the existing CC0 tree atlas. CC0 photo donors: ambientCG LeafSet022 (https://ambientcg.com/view?id=LeafSet022), Poly Haven bark_willow (https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_willow) and palm_tree_bark (https://polyhaven.com/a/palm_tree_bark). Botanical proportions only, no copied reference photos: UF/IFAS (https://ask.ifas.ufl.edu/publication/ST404, https://ask.ifas.ufl.edu/publication/EP443, https://ask.ifas.ufl.edu/publication/MG040).

Near trees round 2: original bamboo, rain-tree/tamarind, melaleuca/eucalyptus and dau/sao-like forest geometry, banana pseudostem texture and branch arrangements. Shared photo donors ambientCG LeafSet022/024 (https://ambientcg.com/view?id=LeafSet022, https://ambientcg.com/view?id=LeafSet024) and Poly Haven bark_willow (https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_willow), CC0; illustrative species adaptations. Shape references only: PROSEA/Naturalis bamboo (https://prosea-bamboos.linnaeus.naturalis.nl/linnaeus_ng/app/views/species/taxon.php?id=95646), NParks rain tree (https://www.nparks.gov.sg/florafaunaweb/flora/3/1/3106), tamarind (https://www.nparks.gov.sg/florafaunaweb/flora/3/1/3174), melaleuca (https://www.nparks.gov.sg/florafaunaweb/flora/3/0/3019), sao (https://www.nparks.gov.sg/florafaunaweb/flora/2/9/2959). No reference pixels copied; forest species identity and canal rows are not surveyed.

Hill woodland: original low branching tree/shrub geometry and exact-mesh side/top silhouettes; shared original/CC0 atlas donors credited in textures/sources.json. Shape references only: Bao An Giang (https://baoangiang.com.vn/tren-dinh-hoc-lanh-son-a396031.html), An Giang tourism (https://media.angiang.gov.vn/SoVHTTDL-Portal/File-Dinh-Kem/thong_tin_du_lich_an_giang.pdf). Reference photographs are private and absent from texture pixels; tall dau is reserved for explicit plantings.

Nui Sam places: original true-scale Blender meshes and procedural palette atlases; no reference-photo pixels included. Footprints: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL, https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1159104301). Architecture/history references: Vietnam National Tourism Authority (https://vietnamtourism.vn/index.php/tourism/items/1242), Nui Sam tourism guide 2024 (https://dulichnuisam.vn/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/NOI-DUNG-PHAT-THANH-1.pdf), An Giang official tourism guide (https://media.angiang.gov.vn/SoVHTTDL-Portal/File-Dinh-Kem/thong_tin_du_lich_an_giang.pdf). Summit pedestal dimensions: Bao An Giang (https://baoangiang.com.vn/tren-dinh-hoc-lanh-son-a396031.html); 2023 restoration date: Nhan Dan (https://nhandan.vn/an-giang-khai-mac-le-hoi-via-ba-chua-xu-nui-sam-post756815.html). Individual photo authors/licences and reported versus estimated dimensions are recorded in the source dossiers.

Nui Cam places: original true-scale Blender meshes and procedural palette atlases; reference photographs are not shipped or used as textures. Site outlines/stations: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL, https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/934549623, https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/934549622, https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/11044270084, https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1189688529). Phat Lon architectural project: TAD Architectura (https://www.tad.vn/du-an/cong-trinh-van-hoa-the-thao/chua-phat-lon.html). Distinct ancillary Thap Xa Loi: OSM node 12747321063 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/12747321063); 2024 Nui Cam tourism photographs (https://www.dulichnuicam.vn/2024/07/thap-xa-loi-phat-nui-cam-vien-ngoc-linh.html), captioned pre-2025 photograph by Pham Hoai Nhan (https://www.amazingvietnam.vn/2021/11/uong-len-nui-cam-chua-phat-lon.html). Statue33.6m base-to-head: Chua Xa Loi (https://chuaxaloi.vn/thong-tin/phat-di-lac-va-pho-tuong-o-nui-cam/1183.html); Cable car opened2015: SGGP (https://www.sggp.org.vn/cuoi-may-len-dinh-cam-son-post20919.html). photo author/licence records accompany the editable sources.

surface.format: zlib RGB8: water confidence, rice cover, signed shore distance (B-128)*2 m
surface.field_layout: illustrative 84 x 128 m plots over lowland WorldCover cropland
surface.crop_channels: R rice cover (surface.py), G paved ground, B town density, A ground kind 160 / lawn 255 / earth 64 (urban.py)
